cr_data.provenance:
1919 - 1986, Georgia O'Keeffe, Abiquiú, New Mexico. 
1986 - 1993, Estate of the artist, Abiquiú, New Mexico. 
1993 - December 27, 1994, The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation, Abiquiú, New Mexico. December 27, 1994, The Museum of Modern Art, New York, acquired as gift from The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation. 
(Source: MoMA, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . On backing: in pencil, by O'Keeffe 'Lake George, Coat and Red,' 1919" [not verified]. Whitney Archive indicates, "No signature. Abstraction." Titled *Lake George with Coat and Red* by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A twisting black form curls in on a small white and blue circle on the upper righthand side of the composition. Surrounding this circle are small, semicircular red forms that resemble flower petals. The bottom two thirds of the background is a rainbow gradient fading from green to yellow to red, white the top third features what appears to be a blue sky with pale blue clouds.
